flags.detail: Consultant's updated rule for micro (< P3M) and small (P3M to < P20M): 10% penalty on amount due; 50% for fraud/willful neglect; interest at 50% of regular rate = 6% p.a.; P500 per violation for failure to submit information, capped P12,500 per year; 50% compromise-penalty reduction for specified non-fraud violations. Reference: RR 6-2024.
flags.action: Use this as the BIR rule in the simulator. The old 25% + 12% rule is removed.

flags.detail: Revised PDF unchanged: SSS 2%/month on unpaid; PhilHealth at least 3% compounded monthly; Pag-IBIG 0.1% per day.
